decision_note: Retained as a direct role-switching near-pass, not as a strict common-fitness experiment.
Arctic mustard paper resolves biochemical/genetic flower-colour polymorphism and geography but does not measure a focal antagonist response to colour in the study.
Ecology Letters Review and Synthesis on floral traits and pathogen transmission is secondary evidence, not an independent primary-study record.
